theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfrcb_cube_partial_ftc
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin (k + 1)) (G : Euclid (k + 1) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → IntegrableOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ G y (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) {y : Euclid (k + 1) | ∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1} ∧ ∫ y in {y : Euclid (k + 1) | ∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1}, fderiv ℝ G y (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = (∫ y in {y : Euclid k | ∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1}, G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth i (1 : ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp y)))) - ∫ y in {y : Euclid k | ∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1}, G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth i (0 : ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp y)))
